C0841.title: Spanish Guardia Civil Dismantles GXC Team AI-Enhanced Phishing Tool Network
C0841.summary: Group-IB disclosed that Spains Guardia Civil dismantled the GXC Team network with its intelligence support and arrested the main developer. The network allegedly operated as Crime-as-a-Service, providing banking phishing and credential-theft tools to criminals and supporting impersonation of financial institutions, government portals, and other targets for fraud. Public materials also described Android malware disguised as banking apps and voice-fraud capability used to induce victims to disclose verification codes, weakening an active banking phishing ecosystem in Spain. The case shows how phishing kits, mobile malware, and voice social engineering can be packaged as a service against bank customer authentication flows, especially second-factor verification steps.
